segments.oily: One reviewer with an oily T-zone and one with combination-oily skin report the product cuts oil and leaves skin clean without stripping it.
segments.dry: Several reviewers with dry skin report it cleanses without tightness or dryness, though one reviewer with normal/dry skin found it too harsh and hard to rinse off.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one prone to oiliness in summer, report it purifies and controls oil while still feeling gentle.
segments.sensitive: Most self-identified sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation, redness or breakouts even with daily use, but a minority describe burning, eye stinging or irritation from the same product.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin report smoother texture, softened fine lines, and one describes it as especially good for mature skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal/dry skin found it harsh and difficult to rinse off despite normal skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging or mature skin report smoothed fine lines and improved skin texture over time.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report it does not dry out skin and even feels moisturizing; one dry-skin reviewer says it resolved recurring dry patches.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report no redness or irritation despite sensitive skin, but a few describe burning, swelling, or irritation immediately after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the product improved her skin's barrier; no dissent noted.
concerns.spots: Reviewers troubled by blackheads and clogged pores report visibly clearer pores and fewer blackheads, generally within one to two uses.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report reduced breakouts and blemishes with regular use; one reviewer experienced a temporary purge of pimples before improvement, and another reports stress and post-menopausal breakouts resolved.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the product removes excess oil and purifies skin, with no reports of increased oiliness.

I have no idea how I managed to go several years without it after my initial try, but being reunited with this Holy Grail truly feels SO good! I can almost literally feel my skin breathe after using this product. Two uses is all it took for my pores to look visibly cleaner -- and I have a serious problem with visible pores on my nose. I did have a few pimples pop up immediately after the second use, but nothing close to a breakout and the rest of my care routine took care of them. Since they were in some of my more notorious problem spots, I suspect this is a result of the detox ingredients drawing the nasties out to the surface of my skin, which is what it's designed to do. Like the headline says: this stuff will make your face so smooth and clean it will literally squeak. I have never experienced that from another skin care product. It's honestly a little scary... but SO satisfying! Genuinely powerful stuff. I can confirm that back when I got the initial sample, the gal doing the demonstration did mention that it can be too harsh for those with sensitive skin.
